instruction: Export the image as a JPEG file named 'computer.jpg' on the Desktop.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully converted image to Indexed (Palette-Based) color mode in GIMP by navigating Image > Mode > Indexed, configuring the Indexed Color Conversion dialog with 256 colors and optimum palette, and clicking Convert. Completed in 9 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menus (Image menu), interact with dialog boxes, handle color profile conversion prompts, convert between image color modes
metadata.task_rationale: Tests GIMP export functionality (File > Export As) with format conversion from PNG to JPEG. The model demonstrated it can navigate GIMP menus and interact with dialogs, so the Export As dialog for JPEG should be within its capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires the agent to export the currently open PNG image as a JPEG file to the Desktop. Evaluator uses vm_command_line to run 'file' on the expected output path and check_include_exclude to verify the output contains 'JPEG', confirming the file was created in the correct format. No postconfig needed since the task itself is about exporting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly runs 'file /home/user/Desktop/computer.jpg' via vm_command_line, which checks both file existence and format at the correct path
Metric check_include_exclude correctly verifies 'JPEG' appears in the file command output, confirming JPEG format
All instruction requirements are covered: file name ('computer.jpg'), location (Desktop at /home/user/Desktop/), and format (JPEG)
If the file does not exist or is not JPEG, the file command output will not contain 'JPEG', correctly returning score 0
No postconfig needed since verification reads a file on disk, not UI state
Parameter handling is correct: check_include_exclude receives the rules dict directly with 'include' key
